title: Vividly Crunchy Canadian Oats Pancakes
description: A malty and crunchy Canadian dish featuring custard powder, perfect for a brunch mood, with a slow-cook and dash-friendly approach.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the oats, flour, custard powder, malt powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes to allow the oats to soak.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot, garnished with fresh fruit or maple syrup if desired.
